THERMAL IMAGING UNIT — QUICK REFERENCE

• Power: sealed cell, ~5 minutes continuous. Conserve.
• The unit renders heat, not light. Warm bodies read white.
• Peripheral vision is severely restricted while worn. Remove before moving through contested corridors.

SECURITY ADDENDUM: If a heat signature appears at rest in a corridor you believed empty — DO NOT RUN. Entities of this class respond to exhaustion and to stillness. Stay rested. Keep moving. Never sleep on this floor.
(Handwritten: they took our goggles when the requisitions were cut. There is one pair left somewhere in the server room or on whoever died wearing them.)
